Roman nummus of Constantine I (306-337 AD) dating from AD 319 - 320. Reece period 15. VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP reverse type. Obverse is laureate bust facing right. Inscription is CONSTAN[...]. Reverse is two Victories standing facing, holding inscribed shield above an altar. Shield inscription appears to be VOT/PR/. Inscription is VICTORIAE LEATAE [PRINC PERP]. Mint unknown
